name: TimeActivity
description: A record of time worked by a vendor or employee.

update.note: Full update; body must include Id and SyncToken and all writable fields (omitted writable fields are set to NULL).

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default. Required for update.

fields.name: NameOf
fields.description: Enumeration of time activity types. Required in conjunction with either EmployeeRef or VendorRef attributes for create operations.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification. Required for update.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date for the time activity. This is the posting date that affects financial statements. If not supplied, the current date on the server is used. Conditionally required.

fields.name: BreakHours BreakMinutes
fields.description: Hours and minutes of break taken between StartTime and EndTime. Use when StartTime and EndTime are specified. Conditionally required.

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: Time that work ends. Required if Hours and Minutes not specified. Conditionally required.

fields.name: Hours
fields.description: Hours worked. Required if StartTime and EndTime not specified. Conditionally required.

fields.name: VendorRef
fields.description: Specifies the vendor whose time is being recorded. Required if NameOf is set to Vendor. Conditionally required.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project ID associated with this transaction. Conditionally required.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced project.

fields.name: HourlyRate
fields.description: Hourly bill rate of the employee or vendor for this time activity. Required if BillableStatus is set to Billable. Conditionally required.

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to a customer or job. Required if BillableStatus is set to Billable. Conditionally required.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Customer.Id of the referenced customer or job.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Customer.DisplayName of the referenced customer or job.

fields.name: EmployeeRef
fields.description: Specifies the employee whose time is being recorded. Required if NameOf is set to Employee. Conditionally required.

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: Time that work starts. Required if Hours and Minutes not specified. Conditionally required.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with this object. Available if Preferences.AccountingInfoPrefs.ClassTrackingPerTxn is set to true.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description of work completed during time activity.

fields.name: Taxable
fields.description: True if the time recorded is both billable and taxable.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Set by Data Services and read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the object was last updated.

fields.name: CostRate
fields.description: Pay rate of the employee or vendor for this time activity.

fields.name: ItemRef
fields.description: Reference to the service item associated with this object (Item.Type is Service).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Item.Id of the referenced service item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Item.Name of the referenced service item.

fields.name: PayrollItemRef
fields.description: Specifies how much the employee should be paid for doing the work specified by the Compensation Id. Available only for a closed group of developers.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: EmployeeCompensation.Id of the referenced payroll compensation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: EmployerCompensation.Name of the referenced payroll compensation.

fields.name: BillableStatus
fields.description: Billable status of the time recorded. Not updatable through an API request; changes automatically when an invoice is created.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: A reference to a Department object specifying the location of this object. Available if Preferences.AccountingInfoPrefs.TrackDepartments is set to true.
